title: Settings

language.title: Language
language.restartHint: The new language shows after FinxWork restarts.

browserNote: This page runs outside the app: its preferences aren't kept.

models.subscriptionNote: Uses each account’s subscription allowance. API keys are billed separately.

chatgpt.note: Sign in with your ChatGPT account

state.needsLogin: Signed out; sign in again in {{name}}

elsewhere.env: Set in your shell configuration; remove {{env}} there
elsewhere.config: Set in ~/.finx/models.toml; edit that file to remove it

source.unsupported: the provider has no model list

actions.open_source: Open the source app, confirm you are signed in, then retry.
actions.authorize: Connect or reconnect and allow Keychain access in the system prompt.
actions.reconnect_account: Disconnect and remove the old connection, then connect the current account.
actions.check_account: Check account or organization permissions in the source app.
actions.retry: Retry later. Existing connections and model catalogs are retained.
actions.check_details: Check the failed step and error code to troubleshoot or contact support.

plans.title: Token Plan
plans.subtitle: Connect your existing model plan
plans.chooseNote: Select your subscription, then enter its API key.
plans.dynamicCatalog: Fetched from the plan service; refreshable
plans.seedCatalog: Plan presets, updated with the app
plans.catalogNote: Preset models do not confirm account access. Availability depends on your subscription.
plans.keyPlaceholder: Paste the API key for this plan
plans.removeNote: Removes the saved key from this device. Your subscription with the provider stays active.
plans.unverified: API key saved, connection not verified yet; your first model request will verify it.

tencent-token-plan.name: Tencent Cloud Token Plan
tencent-token-plan.note: General and Hy share a key

updates.title: Software Update
updates.unsupported: This build doesn't update itself: only releases downloaded from GitHub check for updates.
updates.ready: {{version}} is downloaded and verified, and installs when you quit FinxWork. Restart now to use it; running tasks keep going.
updates.autoDesc: New versions download in the background; you're asked to restart once one is ready.

error.network: Couldn't check for updates. Check your network connection; FinxWork will try again later.
error.location: FinxWork can update itself only from the Applications folder. Move it there in Finder, then try again.
error.download: Couldn't download the update. FinxWork will try again later.

about.env_fallback: Default environment (the login shell did not answer)
about.kernelUpdate: {{server}} (updates to this app’s version when idle)
about.restartBusy: Tasks are running. Restarting interrupts them; their sessions are saved, and a new message continues them.

local.more: Also works with {{names}}; they show up here once installed

live.login: Restore your login in QwenWork, then retry.
live.description: Connect the local QwenWork account to use its models.
live.install: Install QwenWork and sign in first.
live.sourceDescription: Connect your local {{name}} account to use its models.
live.sourceConsent: Use the local {{name}} login to create independent model authorization. Requests count toward the same account usage.
live.degraded: Temporarily offline. The next request will try again.

browser.title: Your browser
browser.off: Open sites that need your sign-ins with your accounts.
browser.on: Sites that need your account open here.
browser.ready: The extension is connected but not in use.
browser.lost: The extension is not connected. Check that FinxWork is on, on the extensions page of {{name}}.
browser.closed: {{name}} isn't open; it connects once you open it.
browser.none: No Chrome, Edge or Brave found.

outdated.extension: The extension in {{name}} is too old; update it.
outdated.finx: The extension is newer than this FinxWork; update FinxWork.

guide.title: Connect Your Browser
guide.install: Add the FinxWork extension to {{name}}. You only do this once:

howto.developer: Turn on “Developer mode” at the top right of the page, and leave it on: Chrome may turn the extension off without it.
howto.drag: Drag the “FinxWork Extension” folder onto the extensions page.

guide.already: Added it before? Find FinxWork on the extensions page and click its reload button.
guide.store: Add the FinxWork extension to {{name}}. You only do this once.
guide.waiting: Waiting for the extension in {{name}} to connect…
guide.notOpen: {{name}} isn't open yet. Open it and the extension connects by itself.
guide.waitHint: Still not connected? On {{name}}'s extensions page, find FinxWork, make sure its switch is on, then click its reload button.
guide.doneHint: Sites that need your accounts now open in your browser, in every conversation from its next step. Turn it off here at any time; closing the “debugging” bar at the top of the browser also takes a tab back.

builtIn.title: Built-in Browser
builtIn.searchDesc: Searches when what you type isn't an address.
builtIn.keywordHint: Type a shortcut in the address bar, then Tab, to search with its engine.

problem.name: Give it a name.
problem.keyword: A keyword is one word, with no spaces.
problem.keywordTaken: Another search engine uses this keyword.
problem.url: The URL starts with http:// or https://, with %s where the search words go.

builtIn.intro: Only affects FinxWork's own browser panel.

browser.sitesEmpty: No sites yet; “Always allow” adds them here.
browser.allSitesDesc: Private network addresses are not included
browser.sitesNote: Shared by both browsers; other sites ask you the first time.
browser.controlOn: Each site asks you the first time.
browser.controlOff: While off, the agent uses no browser.
browser.defaultDesc: Where new pages open unless the agent names one.
browser.refused: FinxWork was just updated; the extension is moving to the new version and will connect in a few seconds.
browser.refusedStuck: The extension is still running the old program. Click its reload button on the extensions page.
browser.elsewhere: This browser is connected to another FinxWork.

desktop.enable: Allow FinxWork to control apps on your computer
desktop.enableDesc: While off, the agent can't use other apps.
desktop.blockedProgram: A part is missing; reinstall FinxWork.
desktop.grantIntro: Computer use needs two macOS permissions: Accessibility lets FinxWork read windows and click and type in them; Screen Recording lets it take screenshots of windows. Even then, each app asks you the first time the agent uses it.
desktop.unsupported: Computer use isn't available on this computer.
desktop.note: Computer use is only for when you ask for it. The agent does not send messages, pay or delete things on its own; it stops and asks you first.
desktop.appsIntro: Apps not listed ask you the first time.
desktop.appsLocked: Grant permission first to set apps.
desktop.appsEmpty: No apps yet; checking “Remember” adds them here.
desktop.permissionsNote: Switch FinxWork on in System Settings, then come back: this page updates by itself. A permission just granted may need FinxWork to restart.
desktop.accessibilityDesc: Reads windows and clicks and types in them; computer use needs it.
desktop.screenDesc: For screenshots of windows; reading and operating windows work without it.
